exposure: Maternal body mass index (BMI) before delivery
maternal body mass index (BMI) before delivery
cohort: Primiparous women with clinical findings suggestive of CPD (n=150)
finding: The study developed and validated a nomogram model based on MRI measurements that could accurately identify primiparous women at risk of cesarean delivery due to CPD.
mod_finding: This study developed and validated a model to predict the risk of cesarean delivery in primiparous women.
